Name: Em's Ladybug Moss
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Replaces moss on the moss-covered trees with a small ladybug or row of mushrooms
Collecting moss makes the ladybug fly away, and leaves a small mossy leaf as a resource
[i]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/P5RvMxSn/Mossdescription.png[/img]
[/i]
Instead of running around, tidying eerie-looking moss on the trees, I turned the moss into ladybugs. You can now choose to let the little ladybugs enjoy their mossy snack, or collect it if you need! When collecting the moss, the ladybug flies away and, in return, leaves you a small mossy leaf. There might be a small hole in the leaf where it took a bite, but the moss on the edges is still intact!

Each season has its own 'moss' version:
Trees in [color=#e69138]spring[/color] get a [color=#e69138]yellow[/color] ladybug when moss grows
Trees in [color=#e69138]summer[/color] get a [color=#e69138]red[/color] ladybug when moss grows
Trees in [color=#e69138]fall[/color] grow [color=#e69138]mushrooms[/color] when moss grows
Trees in winter don't produce moss 

Note: the sprites don't include the green rain trees, as it seemed fitting that those remain a bit eerie
